scientific_integrity: Claims are supported by a constructive proof and reproducible finite checks. The computation does not certify the universal argument. Earlier source results are not claimed as new. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: This is an all-tree purity criterion and pure-complex equality; it does not classify the homotopy or smaller maximal facets of nonpure strong complexes. Earlier path and star cases, and the ordinary pure Morse strong-collapse theorem, are credited as prior results. Unindexed equivalents remain a literature-coverage risk.
title: A diameter-three characterization of pure strong Morse matching complexes of trees
